newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen underpinned by Nissan Life woes.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen underpinned by Nissan Life woes.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are expected to find support on Friday from overnight media reports that Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is preparing to issue an order to halt operations at Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, traders said.
"The reports are a reminder that concerns about Japan's financial system remain. People are likely to be reluctant to sell JGBs," said a trader at a city bank's securities unit.
But the medium-sized life insurer's woes may not be all positive for JGBs if the company is forced to sell its assets, which include bonds, traders said.
